features.title: Difficulty levels and bot personas
features.user_visible_behavior: A user picks from named bots of increasing strength.
verification: Automated match: each level beats the level below in a majority of 20 games.
evidence: Final configuration (search/eval 1a4761d, bots 6859793), paired seeded 6-ply openings, 20 games per pair, GitHub Actions 'Bot strength ladder' (verdict artifacts hold per-game logs with end reason and final FEN): L2 met > L1 bia +19-0=1 (run 34757506393); L3 khon > L2 met +19-1=0 (run 34757502426; L1-L3 unchanged by 6859793); L4 ma > L3 khon +18-0=2 (run 34757853599); L5 ruea > L4 ma +17-0=3 (run 34757849729, all draws by counting); L6 khun > L5 ruea +14-0=6 (run 34757490459 on 1a4761d; L5/L6 configs unchanged by 6859793 — signature in the log: L6 maxDepth 8, 1.5M nodes, no noise; L5 maxDepth 4, 400k nodes, no noise; draws: 3 counting, 2 insufficient material, 1 at the 400-ply cap). Every level beats the level below in a majority of 20 games, with no level losing more than 1 game to the level below.

Supporting checks on the final code: packages/ai unit tests 20 passed (incl. opponent-reply repetition and exact vs narrow root window tests); apps/web/e2e/computer.spec.ts 5/5 (six bots selectable, strongest bot keeps UI animating, hint, takeback); CI verify + deploy green on 6859793 and d65f6fc.
features.notes: 2026-09-13 attempt (not accepted): from the start position L2>L1 +19-0=1, L3>L2 +13-1=6, L4>L3 +17-0=3, L5>L4 +11-1=8, L6 vs L5 +10-0=10 (GitHub Actions run 34748376992). L5 and L6 have no noise, so all 20 L6-L5 games were copies of 2 games (L6 White: win in 161 plies; L6 Black: 400-ply draw) — the ladder was not measuring anything for deterministic bots. Methodology fixed: each pair of games starts from a seeded random 6-ply opening played once with each colour; all pairs re-run with the new method. With openings (search at 0b65b01): L2>L1 +17-1=2, L4>L3 +20-0=0, L5 vs L4 +6-0=14 (fail). Replaying L5-L4 game 3 showed L5 never repeated with its own move — L4 repeated, because search only checked repetition at the root. Fix 9862289: positions after the opponent's reply are checked against game history too (unit test in ai.test.ts); the replayed game became an L5 checkmate win. All pairs re-run on 9862289. L6 khun vs L5 ruea on 9862289: +9-0=11 (run 34751462815, FAIL) — draws: 3 locked-pawn middlegames at the 400-ply cap, 3 roughly level endgames (cap/counting), 3 insufficient material after trades, 2 counting draws L6 did not convert. L6 never lost; the gap to L5 is too small. Depth measurement: L5 stops at its depth cap 4; L6's 1.5M-node budget only completed depth 5 because every root move got a full window. Fix 6e9f87e: noise-free bots skip exact root scores (same move, ~1 ply deeper), L6 depth cap 8 → depth 6 within budget. Ladder on 6e9f87e: L2>L1 +19-1=0, L3>L2 +19-1=0, L4>L3 +20-0=0, L5 vs L4 +10-0=10 (FAIL, run 34756561363): 4 of the draws were counting draws with L5 far ahead. Replay of game 19 showed a flat score for 120 plies while the defending Ruea checked. Fix 1a4761d: endgame trade-down bonus per missing defender piece; the replay became a mate at ply 202. All pairs re-run on 1a4761d. Ladder on 1a4761d: L2>L1 +19-0=1, L3>L2 +19-1=0, L4>L3 +19-0=1, L5 vs L4 +9-0=11 (FAIL, run 34757494907; game 19 now a win, but other won endgames — e.g. three promoted Bia vs bare Khun — still end in counting draws, plus 2 locked 400-ply games and 2 repetitions). L4 had a large margin over L3, so L4 was made weaker (noise 10→30, blunderRate 0→0.02); pairs 3 and 4 re-run. Accepted 2026-09-13 — see evidence. Re-run the ladder (Actions → 'Bot strength ladder', one dispatch per pair) after any change to search, evaluation or bot configs.
